about: A Python library for testing stock trading strategies against historical data.

prs.title: Maximum drawdown is measured from the peak
prs.broken: The maximum drawdown factor divided by the lowest price instead of the peak, so a 50% fall was reported as 100%.
prs.changed: It now returns the largest drop as a fraction of the peak before it.
prs.matters: Strategies that filter or rank stocks by drawdown get the right numbers.
